name: knowledge_consolidate
description: Two-phase knowledge consolidation. First call with action="read_all" to get all entries; then call with action="execute", delete_ids=[...], and/or save_entries=[...] to apply a consolidation plan. The agent analyzes which entries are useful, obsolete, or mergeable.

action.description: "read_all" returns every knowledge entry for analysis; "execute" deletes & saves entries per your consolidation plan.

delete_ids.description: List of entry IDs to delete (only used when action="execute").

save_entries.description: New entries to save (only used when action="execute"). Saved after deletions.
